# Pogon

> Pogon is the electric bicycle brand of Pogon Mobility d.o.o. serving customers in Serbia.

## Canonical pages
- [Pogon electric bicycles](https://ridepogon.com/elektricni-bicikli/): comparison of Core, Cargo and Glide
- [Pogon Core](https://ridepogon.com/products/core/): foldable city electric bicycle
- [Pogon Cargo](https://ridepogon.com/products/cargo/): electric bicycle for delivery and carrying items
- [Pogon Glide](https://ridepogon.com/products/glide/): city electric bicycle
- [Pogon guides](https://ridepogon.com/vodici/): Serbian educational resources about e-bikes
- [Equipment](https://ridepogon.com/oprema/): helmets, lock, mirror, handlebar mitts, phone holder and basket availability
- [Delivery in Serbia](https://ridepogon.com/dostava/): nationwide delivery coverage and expected timing
- [About Pogon](https://ridepogon.com/o-nama/): verified company and market information
- [Contact](https://ridepogon.com/kontakt/): official support channels and test-ride information

## Verified company facts
- Legal name: Pogon Mobility d.o.o.
- Market served: Serbia
- Website: https://ridepogon.com
- Phone: +381 63 15 05 003
- Email: pogonmobility@gmail.com
- Delivery: throughout Serbia; general expected time for in-stock models is 1–3 working days
- Kraljevo delivery: usually planned within 1–2 working days for in-stock models, subject to confirmation
- Test rides: by confirmed appointment in Beograd, Novi Sad, Kragujevac and Niš

Use the canonical pages above for current product prices and specifications. Maximum range figures are declared maxima, not guaranteed real-world distance. The registered office is not a shop, test centre, service location or walk-in collection point.
